AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Represents an authorized administrator of the Nutrition Fellowship CMS.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was last updated.

CmsManifest.title: CmsManifest
CmsManifest.description: Ordered manifest of active item document IDs for a specific website section.

sectionId.description: Identifier of the website section (e.g., hero, highlights, initiatives, resources, recent_events, upcoming_events, announcements, testimonials, team).

itemIds.description: Bounded list (max 25) of CmsItem document IDs belonging to this section in display order.

authorId.description: UID of the admin who created the manifest.

CmsItem.title: CmsItem
CmsItem.description: Individual content item for a website section (slide, highlight, initiative, resource document, event, testimonial, or team member).

sectionId.description: Parent section manifest ID that this item belongs to.

title.description: Primary title, name, or topic of the item.

subtitle.description: Role, date, or secondary heading of the item.

description.description: Body copy, full keynote speech text, quote, biography, or details of the item.

imageUrl.description: Image path, external image URL, or compressed data URL.

linkUrl.description: External link URL or PDF path.

category.description: Category label (e.g., Reports, Policies and Plans, Blogs, Researches, or local PDF flag).

authorId.description: UID of the admin who created the item.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores verified administrator UIDs for RBAC enforcement.

/cms_manifests/{manifestId}.description: Stores the ordered list of active CmsItem IDs for each website section.

/cms_items/{itemId}.description: Stores individual content items referenced by a CmsManifest.
